svg.title: Desktop-Helper: «Пушик» — a pixel cat that lives on top of all windows and teaches 60+ users to use a computer: points with its paw at real buttons, notices when the step is done, explains selected parts of the screen and warns about scams. Works offline. Stack: Electron, TypeScript, UI Automation, Vosk, Groq. Pictured: Pushik, a ginger pixel cat, sits on top of an app window and points at a button
